message.content:
The glow of the smartphone screen was the only light in the living room, casting a sharp, blue-white hue across Maya’s face. She was curled into the corner of the sofa, her thumb hovering over the screen as she typed out a reply to Liam. 

She let out a soft, involuntary giggle, her cheeks flushing a deep, embarrassed pink. It was a dangerous game, texting like this while her roommate, Chloe, was just in the kitchen making tea, but the thrill of the secrecy made it impossible to stop. She hit send, her heart hammering against her ribs, and leaned her head back against the cushions, biting her lip.

"You know, if you’re going to be that loud about it, you might as well put it on the living room TV."

Maya jumped so violently that her phone slipped from her fingers, clattering onto the hardwood floor. She whipped her head around to see Chloe standing in the doorway, a steaming mug in one hand, her eyebrows arched in a mixture of amusement and mild horror.
